scope: Private checker ordinary calls without supplied blocks: block_given?, missing-block yield, evaluation order and exception flow. These whole-function cases have Rust execution witnesses. Prepared block-body summaries have separate runtime comparisons; attached-call integration remains incomplete.

cases.source: def run -> int; if block_given?; missing; else; 7; end; end
cases.difference: Rust knows that this ordinary invocation has no supplied block and skips the unreachable block-given branch. Go warns about its missing name.

cases.source: def helper; block_given?; end; def run; helper(); end
def run -> int; unless block_given?; 7; else; missing; end; end
cases.difference: Rust knows that this ordinary invocation has no supplied block and skips the unreachable block-given branch. Go warns about its missing name.

cases.source: def run; begin; yield missing; rescue LocalJumpError; 7; end; end
cases.difference: Rust diagnoses yield without a supplied block, propagates LocalJumpError and skips yield argument evaluation. Go reports no checker warning.

cases.source: def run; x=0; begin; yield (while true; x=7; break 9; end); rescue LocalJumpError; x; end; end
cases.difference: Rust diagnoses yield without a supplied block, propagates LocalJumpError and skips yield argument evaluation. Go reports no checker warning.

cases.source: def run; begin; yield 7; rescue ArgumentError; missing; rescue LocalJumpError; 7; end; end
cases.note: Both checkers warn. Rust diagnoses the invalid block operation; Go instead warns about a missing name in an expression or branch that execution skips.

cases.source: def run; begin; block_given?(missing); rescue; 7; end; end
cases.note: Both checkers warn. Rust diagnoses the invalid block operation; Go instead warns about a missing name in an expression or branch that execution skips.

cases.source: def run; begin; block_given? {missing}; rescue; 7; end; end
cases.note: Both checkers warn. Rust diagnoses the invalid block operation; Go instead warns about a missing name in an expression or branch that execution skips.

cases.source: def run; x=0; begin; block_given?(bad:(while true; x=7; break 9; end)); rescue; x; end; end
cases.difference: Rust diagnoses arguments to block_given? and preserves the runtime rule that their expressions are not evaluated. Go reports no checker warning.

cases.source: def helper; yield 7; end; def run; begin; helper(); rescue LocalJumpError; 7; end; end
cases.difference: Rust diagnoses yield without a supplied block, propagates LocalJumpError and skips yield argument evaluation. Go reports no checker warning.

cases.source: def run; x=0; begin; yield 7; rescue LocalJumpError; x=2; ensure; x+=1; end; x; end
cases.difference: Rust diagnoses yield without a supplied block, propagates LocalJumpError and skips yield argument evaluation. Go reports no checker warning.
